question.title: Rain Barrel Cascade
question.content:
Rain barrels stand in tiers on a hillside. tiers.get(0) is the top tier and holds one barrel, and tier i holds i + 1 barrels. tiers.get(i).get(j) is the rain that barrel j of tier i collects by itself.

Barrel j of tier i sits under barrels j - 1 and j of tier i - 1, where those exist. Only the fuller of the two overflows into it, and that barrel passes on everything it holds. So a barrel holds its own rain plus the largest amount held by a barrel above it.

Return the largest amount held by any barrel of the bottom tier.

 

Example 1:

Input: tiers = [[2],[3,1],[1,5,2]]
Output: 10
Explanation: The second tier holds 5 and 3. The middle barrel of the bottom tier holds 5 + 5.

Example 2:

Input: tiers = [[7]]
Output: 7

Example 3:

Input: tiers = [[1],[2,9],[4,1,3],[1,1,1,6]]
Output: 19

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= tiers.size() <= 200
  • tiers.get(i).size() == i + 1
  • 0 <= tiers.get(i).get(j) <= 104
